sources.name: Heritage Council
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; local heritage projects
sources.coverage: Community heritage and other heritage grant programmes
sources.format: HTML funding hub; yearly guidelines and grant system

sources.name: Higher Education Authority
sources.coverage: Student assistance, disability access supports, bursaries and higher-education funding discovery
sources.format: Official website seed; follow student-finance and funding links
sources.notes: Institution-administered funds need their local application criteria; HEA programme budgets are not student award amounts.

sources.name: Local Government Management Agency
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; all local authorities
sources.coverage: Local-government services infrastructure, Localgov.ie and national service-catalogue discovery
sources.format: Official website and service-platform announcements
sources.notes: Potential route to request a structured National Services Catalogue feed. No anonymous public API endpoint or reuse licence verified.

sources.name: National Transport Authority
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; service coverage varies
sources.coverage: Transport concessions, accessible transport and programme/fare-support discovery
sources.format: Official pages; links to Transport for Ireland and operators
sources.notes: DSP is the source for Free Travel entitlement. NTA/operator sources define participating services and fare products.

sources.name: Pobal | programme directory
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; local delivery organisations vary
sources.coverage: Community programmes, childcare funding, Seniors Alert and social-inclusion support discovery
sources.format: Programme hubs; HTML and linked guidelines
sources.notes: Pobal administers government-funded programmes. Distinguish grants to delivery bodies from support available to individuals; follow programme-specific eligibility pages.

sources.name: Revenue Commissioners
sources.area: Ireland income-tax system; residence and cross-border rules vary
sources.coverage: Personal tax credits, health and education reliefs, housing reliefs, Help to Buy and business incentives
sources.format: HTML guidance; linked tax manuals and legislation
sources.notes: Tax year and claimant tax liability matter. Follow scheme overview, qualification, rates and claim pages; exclude authenticated myAccount/ROS. Individual rent-credit and Help to Buy pages checked.

sources.name: SOLAS | Further Education and Training
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; ETB and provider delivery
sources.coverage: Further education, training, apprenticeship and learner-support discovery
sources.format: Website and linked programme/provider pages
sources.notes: Follow ETB and course-provider links for local entry rules and allowances; an institution budget is not an individual entitlement.

sources.name: Sport Ireland
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; national and local sports delivery
sources.coverage: Sports development funding, inclusion and local sports partnership programme discovery
sources.format: Official website seed; funding and partnership links
sources.notes: Local sports partnership calls may have distinct eligibility and deadlines. Some capital grants are instead administered directly by the relevant department.

sources.name: Strategic Banking Corporation of Ireland
sources.coverage: Government-backed SME finance and Home Energy Upgrade Loan Scheme
sources.format: HTML product pages, eligibility terms and lender links
sources.notes: Separate current products from Previous Schemes. Credit approval remains lender-dependent; loan principal is not a monetary saving.

sources.name: Sustainable Energy Authority of Ireland
sources.coverage: Home upgrades, fully funded schemes, solar, heat pumps, vehicles and business energy grants
sources.format: HTML grants; technical documents; dated announcements
sources.notes: Follow /grants/home-energy-grants/ and news for effective-date changes. Separate announced measures from implemented application rules and avoid double-counting bundles.

sources.name: Teagasc
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; farm and rural eligibility varies
sources.coverage: Farm scheme guidance, rural enterprise, training and agricultural support discovery
sources.format: Advisory HTML; linked department scheme documents
sources.notes: Use administering-department terms over summaries where rates conflict. Advisory services may carry fees.

sources.name: The Housing Agency
sources.coverage: Affordable housing, mortgage and housing-support programme discovery
sources.format: Official housing resources; linked programme portals
sources.notes: Follow local council property calls for location, price caps and availability. Policy/research pages are not application offers.

sources.name: Tusla | Child and Family Agency
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; local service areas
sources.coverage: Family support, aftercare, foster-care and child-service support discovery
sources.format: Public service pages and policy/guidance documents
sources.notes: Do not crawl case files, referral submissions or personal information. Eligibility can depend on an assessed care status.

sources.name: Údarás na Gaeltachta
sources.area: Designated Gaeltacht areas; scheme-specific geographic rules
sources.coverage: Gaeltacht enterprise, employment, community and development supports
sources.format: English/Irish HTML and programme documents
sources.notes: Deduplicate Irish/English pages. A county name alone is insufficient to determine Gaeltacht eligibility.

sources.name: Access and Inclusion Model | AIM
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; participating early-learning settings
sources.coverage: Universal and targeted inclusion supports for children in ECCE; equipment, expertise and setting supports
sources.format: Public HTML, annual rules and application guidance
sources.notes: Canonical domain has no www. Support is needs-led; a diagnosis is not always required. Often a provider-delivered service, not a cash award to parents.

sources.name: Creative Ireland
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; council and occasional cross-border programmes
sources.coverage: Creative community, youth, wellbeing and climate-related funding calls
sources.format: Grant Calls and Creative Communities navigation; local council links
sources.notes: Government programme. National strategy pages do not replace local council application windows; follow each local call.

sources.name: Electronic Irish Statute Book
sources.coverage: Acts and statutory instruments underpinning benefits, grants and tax reliefs
sources.format: Legislation in HTML and linked documents
sources.notes: Office of the Attorney General service. Use to check legal basis, amendments and commencement, not as a ready-made scheme catalogue. Current consolidated rules and operational guidance may require additional sources.

sources.name: First Home Scheme | official scheme operator
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; local price ceilings and qualifying developments
sources.coverage: Shared-equity home-purchase support, regional caps and redemption terms
sources.format: Official operator criteria, property caps and FAQs
sources.notes: State-supported scheme operator, not a government department. Shared equity and future service charges must not be described as a free grant.

sources.name: Gov.ie master directory of departments, agencies and councils
sources.coverage: Directory enumerates 18 departments, 108 agency/office entries and 31 local authorities
sources.format: HTML directory linking official publishers
sources.notes: Use to discover publishers beyond this priority register. The agency section includes offices/commissions and is not a guarantee of every public body or every grant administrator. Some endpoints reject automated fetches.

sources.name: HAP | all 31 local-authority contacts
sources.coverage: Official council identity/domain roster and HAP application contacts
sources.format: HTML council list and scheme guidance
sources.notes: Contains legacy links in some cases. Resolve redirects and compare council-owned current sites; do not assume stale directory paths are live.

sources.name: Local Authority Home Loan
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; applying local authority and property-area limits
sources.coverage: State-backed local-authority mortgage eligibility, loan terms and application forms
sources.format: HTML criteria, calculators and forms
sources.notes: Record income limits, property-value caps, loan-to-value and credit assessment separately. Mortgage principal is not a grant.

sources.name: Local Enterprise Offices | national portal and 31 local routes
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; one local office route per council area
sources.coverage: Startup grants, expansion, feasibility, digital, energy, mentoring and training supports
sources.format: National HTML catalogue plus local-office pages and application documents
sources.notes: Follow Discover Business Supports and each local office. National rules may have local application processes; local-office selector is partly dynamic. No claim that every local-office page has been crawled.

sources.name: Localgov.ie | national local-government grants catalogue
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; council coverage differs by scheme
sources.coverage: 38 grant/funding entries over four pages: households, community, heritage and business
sources.format: HTML listings and individual scheme pages
sources.notes: Pagination ?page=1, ?page=2, ?page=3. Catalogue explicitly not exhaustive. Several outdated values found: mobility aids, older-person housing aid, repair/leasing. Use as discovery, not unconditional source of truth.

sources.name: Mayo Council | public consultations and applications portal
sources.area: Mayo; municipal-district and scheme boundaries vary
sources.coverage: Public grant calls, expressions of interest and application notices
sources.format: Public HTML portal; some application steps require an account
sources.notes: Capture public scheme notices only. Do not scrape logged-in applications, saved submissions or applicants' personal data. Complements rather than replaces the main council website.

sources.name: National Childcare Scheme
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; registered participating childcare providers
sources.coverage: Universal and income-assessed childcare subsidies; eligibility and subsidy calculator
sources.format: Public portal with some JavaScript-rendered guidance
sources.notes: Extract public rules and rate tables, not authenticated applications or claimant data. Hourly rates require age, income, hours and programme-year context.

sources.name: National Enterprise Hub
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; individual support geography varies
sources.coverage: Cross-agency catalogue of government business supports
sources.format: Searchable/filterable HTML support catalogue; some JavaScript
sources.notes: Government initiative powered by Enterprise Ireland. Follow Browse all supports and then the administering agency. Headline counts differ across page sections, so no exact catalogue total is asserted.

sources.name: Public Service Data Catalogue | Social Protection Schemes
sources.coverage: Metadata describing a list of DSP schemes and links to official information
sources.format: Dataset metadata; potential structured-feed lead
sources.notes: Metadata states API Available: Yes, monthly updates, but Open Data: No. An anonymous API endpoint, access conditions and reuse licence were NOT verified. This is a lead for requesting access, not a confirmed public API for the crawler.

sources.name: SUSI | Student Universal Support Ireland
sources.area: Ireland; eligible study locations vary by grant
sources.coverage: Maintenance and fee grants; undergraduate, PLC, postgraduate and part-time routes
sources.format: HTML annual income/rate tables and application guidance
sources.notes: Store academic year, reference income year, course type, distance band and fee-versus-maintenance component. Public guidance only, not student accounts.

sources.name: Citizens Information | Citizens Information Board
sources.area: Republic of Ireland; cross-border topics where specified
sources.coverage: Cross-department public guidance on benefits, housing, health, education and local services
sources.format: Public guidance website; linked administering-body pages
sources.notes: Publicly funded information service, not the primary administrator of most schemes. Use for discovery and explanations, then verify rates and rules with the administering body. Main-site fetch was unreliable. No production API or bulk-reuse permission verified.

sources.name: Microfinance Ireland
sources.coverage: Government-funded small-business lending and local referral routes
sources.format: Operator HTML and loan-package terms
sources.notes: Government-funded not-for-profit lender, not a government department. Current operator/LEO pages show up to €50,000; Localgov's €25,000 summary is stale. Loans are not grants.
